watch_tier.instructions: For optional monitoring beyond mandatory deterministic checks, which relative watch tier deserves additional scheduling resources? Do not infer liquidation eligibility or transaction profitability.

criteria.high: Strong reason to give this account extra discretionary monitoring
criteria.normal: No strong reason to adjust baseline optional-monitoring frequency
criteria.low: Low priority for extra checks only; never waive mandatory checks

extra_preparation.instructions: Is extra optional route preparation likely to be useful relative to similar non-urgent tracked accounts?

monitoring_value.instructions: How valuable is extra monitoring, based only on the supplied evidence?
